title: Conversation With No. 50 Russian Social Revolutionist

page_data.en:
1. O. 6722
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Intelligence Office Station.
October 31, 1925.
REPORT ON Conversation with No. 50 (Russian Social Revolutionist).
Made by Tem. Con. Cook Forwarded by J.W. Evens C. S. I.
Sir,
There are two group of Cossacks at present at Shanghai.
Both these groups represent the remnant of the detachment that
arrived here on board the Russian steamer belonging to the
so called Ataman Gleboff. Altogether there were approximately
1000 men landed here in Shanghai under the command of Gleboff.
The majority of these Cossacks left some time ago for
Soviet Russia, but the remainder, some 300 men, are now divided;
50 of them recognizing a certain Kozakov and the balance
recognize Ataman Gleboff. Those recognizing Kozakov are
not armed, whereas Gleboff's men are. The former are engaged in
ordinary labouring work while those under Gleboff are paid
a monthly allowance and are fed clothed etc. The Glebovites
are quartered at stations on board the Russian military
transport "Odmatsk" moored somewhere on the river. The
discipline existing among these Glebovites is strict. The
majority of these Cossacks are from Trans Baikalie, the others
are from Ussuri in the Pro-Martime Province.
The funds supporting these Glebovites are supposed to
represent the following:-
(1) Money received by Gleboff from the Japanese for work
conducted by these Cossacks in Korea prior to their
arrival here.
(2) From the sale of arms to Chinese.
(3) From the sale of a Russian steamer or mortgage of
same.

1. O. 6722
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
情报科分站。
1925年10月31日。
关于与第50号线人（俄国社会革命党人）谈话的报告。
由临时警员库克（Tem. Con. Cook）撰写，经首席巡长 J.W. Evens 转呈。

先生，
目前上海有两伙哥萨克人。
这两伙人均代表随所谓“阿塔曼”（Ataman，哥萨克首领）格列博夫（Gleboff）所属的俄国轮船抵达此处的分遣队之残余力量。在格列博夫的指挥下，登陆上海的总人数约为1000人。
这些哥萨克人中的大多数已于此前一段时间前往苏维埃俄国，但剩余的约300人目前分为两派；其中50人效忠某位科扎科夫（Kozakov），其余人则效忠阿塔曼格列博夫。效忠科扎科夫者未携带武器，而格列博夫的手下则持有武器。前者从事普通的体力劳动，而格列博夫麾下人员则领取月薪，并由当局提供食宿及衣物等。格列博夫派系的人员驻扎在停泊于黄浦江某处的俄国军用运输船“Odmatsk”号（音译）上的营房中。格列博夫派系内部纪律严明。这些哥萨克人多数来自外贝加尔地区，其余则来自滨海省的乌苏里地区。
据信，供养这些格列博夫派系的资金来源于以下方面：
(1) 格列博夫从日本人处获得的款项，系这些哥萨克人在抵达上海前在朝鲜开展行动所得。
(2) 向中国人出售武器所得。
(3) 出售一艘俄国轮船或对该船进行抵押所得。

Made by ________________________ Forwarded by ________________________

3000 Russian rifles, 6 or 7 machine guns, and 3 x 3" field pieces
The major portion of the above armaments have been surreptitiously
sold here. Money was received both for the sale of one of the
Russian boats, and the mortgage of another.

An estimate of the total expenditure required for the upkeep
of these Cossacks works out at $6,000 a year. The ostensible
object for retaining these Cossacks here is to defend the rights
of the White Russian elements in connection with extraterritoriali-
ty; but the real object is political, the intention being to
boost the existence of armed Cossacks (anti-Reds) in order to keep
the flame of Imperialism alive. It also forms a good graft as a
means for collecting money from America. The Russian population
numbering some 15,000 persons view the
presence of this armed detachment with fear and have been
opposed to the idea ever since its birth, but the recent action
of the Chinese authorities at Nanking where several Russian
traders were beheaded on the grounds of being suspected as spies
has produced a decided feeling against Gleloff and his men.
Ataman Gleloff in the Czar days was a sergeant and his rank of
Ataman has been practically speaking self appointed.
Lieutenant General N. S. Savalioff is in charge of these
Cossacks. He left Shanghai two days ago for Tsingtao and
the reason of his departure is considered by many to be in
connection with Wu Pei Fu's proposed military activities.
It appears that Savalioff is acting agent for Nikolai Merkuloff,
(of the former Imperial Government at Vladivostock in
1920) who is the chief of the Intelligence Department for

3000支俄式步枪、6或7挺机枪以及3门3英寸野战炮。
上述武器装备的大部分已在此地秘密售出。出售其中一艘俄国船只以及对另一艘船只进行抵押均获得了款项。

估算维持这些哥萨克人所需的年度总支出为6,000美元。将这些哥萨克人留驻上海的表面目的是为了保护白俄势力在治外法权方面的权益；但真实目的具有政治性，其意图是通过维持武装哥萨克人（反赤分子）的存在，使帝国主义之火不熄。这也成为一种良好的敛财手段，用以从美国筹集资金。总数约15,000人的俄国侨民群体对这支武装分遣队的存在感到恐惧，并自其成立之初便反对这一做法，但最近中国当局在南京的行动——以涉嫌间谍罪为由处决了几名俄国商人——引发了针对格列博夫（Gleloff）及其手下的强烈反感情绪。
阿塔曼格列博夫（Gleloff）在沙皇时代仅是一名军士，其阿塔曼的头衔实际上是自封的。
尼古拉·萨瓦利奥夫（N. S. Savalioff）中将负责指挥这些哥萨克人。他于两天前离开上海前往青岛，许多人认为其离开的原因与吴佩孚拟议的军事行动有关。
看来，萨瓦利奥夫是作为尼古拉·梅尔库洛夫（Nikolai Merkuloff）的代理人在行事，梅尔库洛夫曾是1920年符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）前帝国政府的成员，现任

Form No. 2
G.10000-8-25

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 6722
Date 2.11.25.

Shanghai Municipal Police.

Station.
192

REPORT ON

Made by ________________________ Forwarded by ________________________

General Chang Chung Chang, the Tupan of Shantung. General
Chang Chung Chang was formerly a Tunghuse operating on the
Manchurian-Russian border as the aide Gen Nikolai Merkuloff
was connected with a Russian Steamship Co. operating on the
rivers Sungari and Amur. While pursued by the authorities,
Chang Chung Chang sought refuge with Merkulov who aided him
and so the general recompensed his old confederate by promoting
him to the post of chief of the Intelligence Department.

I am. Sir,
Your obedient servant,
John Knox
Com. Com.

D. C. I.
